src/server/IncomeService.luau ```lua local IncomeService = {} local PlayerStates = {} local rng = Random.new(424242) function IncomeService.InitPlayer(player) PlayerStates[player.UserId] = { Cash = 250, Multiplier = 1, Owned = {} } end function IncomeService.TickPlayers(delta) for userId, state in pairs(PlayerStates) do local incomePerSecond = 0 for _, char in pairs(state.Owned) do local income = char.Income * state.Multiplier if char.IsShiny then income *= 3 end incomePerSecond += income end state.Cash += incomePerSecond * delta end end function IncomeService.BuyCharacter(player, plot, catalogEntry) local state = PlayerStates[player.UserId] if state.Cash >= catalogEntry.Price then state.Cash -= catalogEntry.Price local isShiny = rng:NextInteger(1, 12) == 1 local char = { Name = catalogEntry.Name, Price = catalogEntry.Price, Income = catalogEntry.Income, Color = catalogEntry.Color, Rarity = catalogEntry.Rarity, IsShiny = isShiny } table.insert(state.Owned, char) return true, char end return false end function IncomeService.Rebirth(player) local state = PlayerStates[player.UserId] local counts = {} for _, char in pairs(state.Owned) do counts[char.Name] = (counts[char.Name] or 0) + 1 end local canRebirth = false for _, count in pairs(counts) do if count >= 5 then canRebirth = true break end end if canRebirth then state.Owned = {} state.Multiplier += 0.5 state.Cash = 250 return true, state.Multiplier end return false end function IncomeService.Snapshot(player) local state = PlayerStates[player.UserId] local incomePerSecond = 0 for _, char in pairs(state.Owned) do local income = char.Income * state.Multiplier if char.IsShiny then income *= 3 end incomePerSecond += income end return { Cash = state.Cash, Multiplier = state.Multiplier, OwnedCount = #state.Owned, IncomePerSecond = incomePerSecond, PlotSlotsFree = 10 - #state.Owned } end return IncomeService ``` ### ServerScriptService.Server.PlotService ModuleScript, 99 lines, matched to
